verdict.rationale: No dedicated sandbox or staging environment is documented. The closest evidence is indirect: Connector SDK agent plugins let users "build, test, and deploy connectors" before deployment. The MCP server can copy existing connections to a new destination, which could serve as a test target. MCP defaults to read-only scope, with write and delete unlocked only by explicit configuration. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment isolated from production data, explicit details of how Connector SDK testing avoids production, independent or hands-on corroboration.
